releaseNotes: AURA 3.9.4 corrects the Auto-Mix decision model: balance and peak-headroom corrections are combined, never substituted, so a peak slightly over the selected ceiling can no longer turn a large balance correction into "Level is on target". Every row states what drove it, and action text, badge and evidence always agree. HEADROOM (over the -6/-3/-1 dBFS ceiling) is now distinct from CLIPPING (at or above 0 dBFS). The REF row reads REFERENCE SET with its held level. The Genre EQ Guide gives every profile a workflow line with corrected zone data. Also includes the 3.9.1-3.9.3 sender diagnostics and sparse-kick program-RMS reference work. Fully close the DAW before installing.
